title: System for automatic storage and withdrawal of objects, and object transfer device used in the system

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.note: This reference describes an object transfer device with handling means for moving containers, but it does not mention a housing with a grip portion or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion, let alone one that is a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device or the routing of exhaust air.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion or a sound-damping device.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: This reference describes an object transfer device with handling means, but none of the specific components of a grip unit as described in the feature are present.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: This reference describes an object transfer device but does not mention a vacuum handling apparatus, suction plate, carrier plate, seal, or the specific grip unit components.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion or sound-damping material.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device or its arrangement within a housing.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: This reference does not describe a housing portion with a sound-reducing device or lining.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion or multiple housing portions with an air outlet.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: This reference does not describe an air collection screw, grip portion, or exhaust air collection.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: This reference does not describe air baffles, a grip portion, or exhaust air guidance.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: This reference does not describe a battery coupling point, air baffles, or exhaust air direction.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip unit, suction plate, or a releasable coupling device for them.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip unit, suction opening, suction chamber, or suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes an object transfer device for storage and retrieval systems, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
This reference describes a support structure and handling means for moving object containers, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device, and does not mention any sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference does not describe a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.
This reference does not describe a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes an object transfer device with housing areas and handling means, but it does not describe a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet on a second housing portion.
This reference describes an object transfer device, but it does not describe an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the collection of exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.
This reference describes an object transfer device, but it does not describe air baffles, bent or curved, for guiding exhaust air emerging from a grip portion to an air outlet.

This reference describes an object transfer device, but it does not describe a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on a housing, or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
This reference does not discuss air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system for storage and retrieval, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not describe a suction plate, carrier plate, or seal fastened to a carrier plate.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference does not describe a grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device.
This reference does not describe a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum for lifting objects.

overall.why: This reference describes a system for automatic storage and withdrawal of objects using a transfer device with handling means for containers, which is a different technical area from the subject invention's vacuum handling apparatus.
